body.x: MAP Tech (www.maptech.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, unveiled wireless smartphone charget, 'm-cloud' at '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11.

'm-cloud' was composed of Compact type and Tilt-type wireless power transmitter. In case of compact type, you just put it on the charging station for automatic charging. In other case, you can recharge a variety of wireless charger in state of rising or descending by adjusting the tilt.
'm-cloud' has chosen International Standard on 'wireless charging method' and certified with 'Qi' on WPC International Standard. It also provides classy design with its convenience.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
